notes.title: Retovamp is now localized in 7 languages
notes.notes:
I'm really glad to announce that from today Retrovamp is available in 7 different languages:
[list]
[*]English
[*]Italian
[*]German
[*]French
[*]Russian
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Spanish
[/list]

notes.title: Retrovamp minor update
notes.notes:
Here is a list of the patch notes:

[list]
[*] In some rare occasions players were unable to spawn checkpoints, this bug has been fixed
[*] Fixed a minor bug that prevented the scoreboard to be correctly updated
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the volume options to be saved
[*] Player controller minor value tweaks
[/list]

Remember to join the official discord server at: https://discord.gg/zJ9ysw2

notes.title: Official Retrovamp discord
notes.notes:
Discord is an amazing service that can help people communicate fast and easily, so why not using it to gather people that like this game?

That's why I decided to create a Discord server for Retrovamp where people can come and chat with me and with other people who enjoy the game now that only 10 days are left before the release!

In the server there are also some sections dedicated to content creators that might want to share their video/article/... about Retrovamp!

So, what are you waiting for? Come have a chat at: https://discord.gg/zJ9ysw2

If you missed it here's the game trailer available on youtube: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cfp4OKgGm2k
